name: Utah
overview: Utah draws limited-entry, once-in-a-lifetime and CWMU big game, black bear and spring turkey permits with bonus points: half of each hunt's permits go to the applicants with the most points and the rest are drawn randomly, with an extra random number per point. General-season buck deer, antlerless deer, antlerless elk and doe pronghorn are drawn by preference point, so the applicants with the most points draw first. Each hunt is identified by a hunt number (e.g. EB3006), and published odds count first-choice applications only. General-season bull elk, bear harvest-objective and spring general-season turkey permits are sold over the counter, and cougar needs only a hunting license.

species.drawSystemSummary: Limited-entry and once-in-a-lifetime permits use bonus points: 50% of each hunt's permits go to the applicants with the most bonus points (first choice), and the rest are drawn randomly, with an extra random number for each bonus point held. Antlerless elk permits are drawn by preference point. General-season any-bull, spike-bull and archery elk permits are sold over the counter, not drawn.
species.pointName: bonus point (limited-entry bull elk); preference point (antlerless elk)
species.residentNote: Residents may apply for one limited-entry permit (or bonus point) and one once-in-a-lifetime permit (or bonus point) each year; bull elk waiting period after drawing is five years.
species.nonresidentNote: Nonresidents may apply for limited-entry bull elk but not for CWMU permits through the big game drawing; resident and nonresident quotas are set per hunt.
species.otcSummary: General-season archery elk (July 7, 2026), any bull elk (July 9, 2026) and spike bull elk (July 16, 2026) permits went on sale over the counter; remaining antlerless permits from July 28, 2026.

species.drawSystemSummary: General-season buck deer permits are drawn by preference point (applicants with the most points draw first; points are lost when a permit is drawn), with 20% of general-season permits allocated to youth. Antlerless deer are drawn by preference point.
